entities.summary: Varaidzo (Vee) Kativhu is a 27 year old British-Zimbabwean double doctorate holder, girls' education activist, an international speaker, author and social-media personality. She has received a Diana Award and been listed on the BBC's 100 Women list in 2023 as a "Content creator and YouTuber".
